title: Dragones y Dirigibles
description: Modpack about fantasy, roleplaying and Create Aeronautics.
body:
# General description
Minecraft Modpack centered in exploration and roleplaying with Aeronautics and fantasy mods. Build your own Dirigible (hot air balloon) and get ready to fight some dragons with your friends.

If you're not a fighter, you can make your own tavern with Let's Do Winery or your witch cult with Hexerei.

Watch here all you can do in Dirigibles y Dragones!

![Wall with photos and red strings linking them](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1e24eaf42b7793a4338f5efb4f10ec0f42c661d.png)

## Surviving

Healing is not as easy as usual, as it has been nerfed. In order to stay alive in battle you'll need to find external ways of regeneration, going from vanilla potions, to 

![Wall with photos linked by a red string showing all the different way you can heal in the pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1b6b1aa0c8806162d249f764522e4864355afa13.png)

You'll also need to get care of your temperature in order to survive. Try sewing insulation on your armor or heat sources, such as lava running trough pipes or soul flames or ice if you need cooling.

Coordinates and useful info has been removed from the F3 Menu. In order to navigate the world you should use compasses, lodestones, maps and other gadgets you'll find.

## Creating

For the Create part of the pack there's only base Create and Aeronatics in terms of adding content. You can also find Copycats+, Gyroscope, Climbable Ropes and Portable Engine Liquid Fuel. But that's more than enough.

![Polaroid of a hot air balloon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3386dea1ba051874be0ac3b4bf0c5bd5f15f4f31.png)

## Magic

With Hexerei and Relics you'll live to the fantasy of being a witch flying in your broom, making witchcraft and taming familiars.

![Book of Shadows onto an altar with the moon on the background](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b0ead678b795d89b10dcc612f1e6057f12957399.png)

## Dragons

Find and raise your very own dragon 
![Red dragon soaring the sky](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/542779323f52998a9a368bda6d0d7f7e92ae5526.png)
